column1: # The relations between tasks that `blocked_by:` cannot carry. AUTHORED, not derived.
# `blocked_by:` in a task file is the ONE home for a blocking edge, because kit-plan.sh reads
# it and nothing reads this file. Everything here is a relation that is real, was written in
# prose, and is NOT an ordering constraint -- recorded so it stops being rediscovered, and so
# the next reader can tell "we decided this is not a blocker" from "nobody looked".
# not-a-blocker the source task states in its own body that this is deliberately not a blocker
# sequencing    an ordering the source argues for and did not declare; cheaper one way round
# co-decide     two tasks whose answers must agree; declaring either direction would be wrong
# subsumes      doing dst closes most of src as a side effect
# split-from    deliberately split siblings, split so the cheap half is not held behind the dear one
# file-conflict same file or same lines; a merge order, not a dependency
# instance-of   src is one instance of the defect class dst names
# umbrella-member  src is a design task whose scope covers dst; see DEPENDENCIES.md, open decision 1
# related       context only -- the source cites dst to explain itself
# Rebuild the candidate set (every T- id in a body that is not in that file's blocked_by):
